title: the day before winter solstice
markdown:
Unconsciously, the year is coming to an end. Yesterday, the property manager of the community sent a warm reminder:
> Warm heart-warming ginger tea, warm and never closed
Property provides convenience to the people and services to the industry
A cup of warm ginger tea🍵 will start your day full of energy
Delivery time: 8:30 a.m. on December 20
Delivery location: East and south entrance of the community
Xiao Guan looks forward to seeing you [Rose]
It turns out that the winter solstice is coming soon, and at this time last year, the property management staff handed out ginger tea at the gate of the community. The mood was different these two times. Last year, I felt it was a surprise and a sense of ceremony. This year, I felt that the property management was thoughtful and had to drink this cup. After letting my wife take the ginger tea, she said: "Thank you."

This year is a year with many feelings:
- If the environment is not good, how long can we survive?
- Is there still trust between people?
- Is this still edible?
- Look more often when crossing the road

The more this happens, the more you cherish the kindness of those around you. So I have respect for the property staff.

This year is also a year of strong desire for expression, but I have been slow to update my blog. One fundamental reason is that I feel that other people's writing is too good, and my own journal is too bad. Whether it is the title or the content, I have to worry about whether the writing is not very good, whether it is too wordy, how to write to attract other people's attention, etc. Just now I was still struggling with the title. The title clearly said "The Day Before the Winter Solstice", but the first paragraph took place on the day before the Winter Solstice, and then it was deleted and revised again. Suddenly I understood why I wanted to change it. I just wrote about my truest feelings at the moment. Write however you want.

Returning to the warm-hearted gesture of the property management staff, I didn’t care too much about such details before, but this year I care about them very much. Especially in a field that I don’t belong to and people I am not familiar with, it is really valuable to have a little trust.

Writing this today is a good start.
